Polluted Area Proclamations

Proclamations

PA-47-2026

This proclamation closes the following areas in New Hanover County: A portion of Masonboro Sound, Middle Sound, and Pages Creek.

Effective Date: Shellfish Temporary Closures effective at 8:00 a.m., Monday, September 7, 2026.

Issued Date: 9/7/2026

Counties Affected: New Hanover

PA-46-2026

This proclamation closes the following areas in Onslow and Carteret Counties: Chadwick Bay, Salliers Bay, Freeman Creek, Bear Creek, Queens Creek, White Oak River, a portion of Bogue Sound, Deer Creek, Hunting Island Bay, Goose Creek, Sanders Creek, Newport River, Core Creek, a portion of North River, and Ward Creek.

Effective Date: Shellfish Temporary Closures effective at 7:45 a.m., Sunday, September 6, 2026.

Issued Date: 9/6/2026

Counties Affected: Onslow and Carteret

PA-45-2026

This proclamation returns the following areas to normal closure boundaries: A portion of Topsail Sound, Virginia Creek, Beckys Creek, Stump Sound, Alligator Bay, and Adams Creek.

Effective Date: Shellfish reopenings effective at sunrise, Saturday, September 5, 2026.

Issued Date: 9/4/2026

Counties Affected: Pender, Onslow, Carteret, and Craven.

PA-44-2026

This proclamation returns the following areas to normal closure boundaries: Bay River and Jones Bay.

Effective Date: Shellfish reopenings effective at sunrise, Friday, September 4, 2026.

Issued Date: 9/3/2026

Counties Affected: Pamlico

PA-43-2026

This proclamation returns the following areas to normal closure boundaries: Middle Sound, Pages Creek, and Queens Creek.

Effective Date: Shellfish reopenings effective sunrise, Thursday, September 3, 2026.

Issued Date: 9/2/2026

Counties Affected: New Hanover and Onslow

PA-42-2026

This proclamation returns the following areas to normal closure boundaries: A portion of Topsail Sound, Chadwick Bay, Oyster Creek, and South River.

Effective Date: Shellfish reopenings effective sunrise, Wednesday, September 2, 2026.

Issued Date: 9/1/2026

Counties Affected: Pender, Onslow and Carteret

PA-41-2026

This proclamation closes the following areas in Brunswick, Onslow, and Pamlico Counties: Ocean Isle Beach, Alligator Bay, Chadwick Bay, Bay River, and Jones Bay.

Effective Date: Shellfish Temporary Closures effective at 7:50 a.m., Sunday, August 30, 2026.

Issued Date: 8/30/2026

Counties Affected: Brunswick, Onslow, and Pamlico.

PA-40-2026

This proclamation returns the following areas to normal closure boundaries: Bear Creek, Newport River, Core Creek, North River, Whitehurst Creek, Sleepy Creek, Jarrett Bay, Brett Bay, and Nelson Bay.

Effective Date: Shellfish reopenings effective sunrise, Saturday, August 29, 2026.

Issued Date: 8/28/2026

Counties Affected: Onslow and Carteret

PA-39-2026

This proclamation returns the following areas to normal closure boundaries: Shinn Creek and a portion of Topsail Sound.

Effective Date: Shellfish reopenings effective at sunrise, Friday, August 28, 2026.

Issued Date: 8/27/2026

Counties Affected: New Hanover and Pender

PA-38-2026

This proclamation closes the following areas in Pender, Onslow, Carteret, and Craven Counties: Stump Sound, a portion of North River, Nelson Bay, Adams Creek, and South River.

Effective Date: Shellfish Temporary Closures effective at 7:50 a.m., Tuesday, August 25, 2026.

Issued Date: 8/25/2026

Counties Affected: Pender, Onslow, Carteret, and Craven
